name: 9 Nile Residence
shortDescription: Off-plan estate of 58 four-bedroom houses and pool villas by Arthouse in Chalong, with a clubhouse, communal pool and gym, due December 2027.
description:
9 Nile Residence is a gated estate of 58 homes by Arthouse on the Palai side of Chalong, in the south-east of Phuket. It offers two products: compact two-storey four-bedroom houses of about 210 sqm on plots of about 250 sqm, and larger four-bedroom pool villas, both in a Mediterranean style with arched windows and warm render.
The estate has a clubhouse, a communal pool, a gym, parking and 24-hour security, and pets are allowed. Chalong Pier is about 5.5 km away and the airport about 58 minutes by car; the south-coast beaches of Rawai and Nai Harn and the shops of Chalong are a short drive.
The project is off plan with completion scheduled for December 2027. The payment plan follows construction stages from a THB 300,000 deposit to handover.
